question: As of Dec 2020 who was the Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs in the Union Cabinet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pralhad Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pralhad Joshi has been serving as the Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs since May 30, 2019.
 
• He is also the Minister of Coal and Minister of Mines in the Government of India.
 
• He represents the Dharwad constituency of Karnataka in the Lok Sabha.
 
• Pralhad Joshi is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been actively involved in politics since the 1990s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs**

 
 
• The Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs is responsible for the functioning of the parliamentary system in India.
 
• The ministry ensures smooth functioning of both the Houses of Parliament (Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha).
 
• The Minister is responsible for coordinating with various political parties and facilitating discussions and debates in the Parliament.
 
• The ministry also plays a significant role in managing the legislative business of the government in the Parliament.
 
 
 
• **Pralhad Joshi**
 
 
• Pralhad Joshi is a senior politician from Karnataka, representing the Dharwad constituency in the Lok Sabha.
 
• He has held various important positions within the BJP and has been an active member of the party since the 1990s.
 
• In addition to his role as Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs, he also holds the portfolios of Minister of Coal and Minister of Mines.
 
• He has been instrumental in various legislative and policy-making processes related to his ministries.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs**
 
 
• The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs is one of the key ministries in the Government of India.
 
• It was established in 1949 and plays a crucial role in the functioning of the Indian Parliament.
 
• The ministry is responsible for the coordination of legislative activities and ensuring the smooth functioning of parliamentary proceedings.
 
• It also acts as a bridge between the government and the opposition parties, facilitating dialogue and cooperation.
